description: Starts the first research on one core competitor that has none yet: Debriefing reads its site and outside sources. It uses one update from the weekly research allowance. Admin only. Send an idempotency_key. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the first answer and does not act again. It starts no second job and uses no allowance or daily cap a second time.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make for this request, such as a UUID. Send the same key when you retry, and Debriefing returns the first answer instead of acting twice.

name: research_competitor

replayed.description: True when this answer repeats an earlier call with the same idempotency_key.

title: Research a competitor
